channel.title: agalera.eu
channel.description: Adrian Galera’s blog, agalera.eu, offers insightful software development articles and practical coding tips for modern developers

item.title: Avoiding repeated points in a leaflet map
item.description: Use a QuadTree in Leaflet to remove duplicate points, significantly reducing file size and boosting performance with smart deduplication and testing.

item.title: Implementing a dog bark detector
item.description: Using machine learning with python to detect when my dog barks and send a telegram message when it happens

item.title: Latitude,longitude bounds
item.description: This post describe the basic algorithm to calculate the bounds of a set of points coordinates with latitude and longitude.

item.title: Browser storage
item.description: How to store data in browser in order to make standalone apps without backend. This articles explores using browser localstorage and caches.

item.title: Classify malware with machine learning and image analysis
item.description: Turn malware into images and detect threats with Convolutional Neural Networks.

item.title: Code interview cheatsheet
item.description: A concise summary of Cracking the Coding Interview highlighting the most important data structures, algorithms, and problem-solving strategies used in technical interviews.

item.title: Combine two Java Optionals
item.description: I was implementing a searching algorithm and I had to search for two things. In this article I describe how I implemented combining two Java optionals in Java 9 using Optional.or compared with Java 8

item.title: Geolocation wordpress with leaflet
item.description: Build a geolocation-enabled WordPress site with Docker Compose. Create a "piulada" category and map posts using custom markers.

item.title: Download all tracks from Suunto
item.description: Automate downloading Suunto tracks using JS & Playwright. Bypass captchas, extract workout IDs, and export GPX files seamlessly.

item.title: Download historic files from Internet Archive
item.description: Automate retrieval of historic website copies from Internet Archive to create ML text datasets using Python, Playwright, and wget.

item.title: Building a home alarm with an ESP32 and a testable state machine
item.description: How I designed a home alarm on an ESP32-S3: an explicit state machine, a hardware abstraction layer that lets me run the firmware on my laptop, and a Telegram integration that can never block the siren.

item.title: Custom built autopilot for flight simulators
item.description: In this post I describe how I created from scrach a physical controller for autopilot in flight simulators.

item.title: Password protection for Github Pages
item.description: How to protect a static page served from Github pages with password and avoid link sharing without using any backend

item.title: Gitlab improvements: caches and Docker
item.description: This post describe how I can manage to reduce the time consumed by Gitlab pipelines by caching the dependencies and using Docker images

item.title: Golang abstract class
item.description: I'm doing a side project using golang, and I have a use case where I'd use an abstract class in Java. Unfortunately, in golang the concept of classes does not exist. In this article I describe how can I implement the behaviour I want without abstract class.

item.title: Grafana, nginx reverse-proxy and Docker
item.description: Deploy Grafana using Docker and nginx as reverse-proxy providing health-check and more advanced features such as blocking requests.

item.title: Echo request body into wiremock response
item.description: Echo request fields directly in your Wiremock responses! Learn how to return the data from HTTP request bodies using Wiremock’s response templating.

item.title: Java big memory limit
item.description: Playing around with JVM options, we question ourselves; what would happen if we set the minimum memory to be greater than the available memory?

item.title: Java Unit Test to check UTF-8 chars
item.description: We have experienced an issue with UTF-8 characters in Java and we have designed a unit test to prevent that to happen again.

item.title: Java 11 negative symbol in Swedish
item.description: We performed a migration to Java 11 and a bug fix about negative symbol for negative numbers in Java ruined our implementation. This article describes the situation and the lessons learned.

item.title: Draw a polygon from markers in leaflet
item.description: I want to add some markers to the map and to create a polygon that joins them to display them nicely in a leaflet map

item.title: Leaflet fog of war
item.description: When I was playing age of empires the map was all in black color at the beginning. As long as you explore the map, the black color is removed discovering what it was hidden behind. I wanted to implement something similar in a leaflet map. I'll describe the callenges I have found in a series of articles.

item.title: Load GPX in leaflet
item.description: Following up from the previous article about implementing the fog of war in leaflet, I want to be able to load a GPX file and display it in the map

item.title: Using maching learning to fight SMS spam
item.description: Ever wondered how AI can filter out those annoying spam SMS? In this post, I explore how machine learning models are trained to detect spam SMS using real-world techniques

item.title: Mocking external API with wiremock
item.description: Mocking external API with wiremock. Prepare a docker-compose bootstrap project for wiremock.

item.title: Mockito ArgumentCaptor with inheritance
item.description: Working with Mockito's ArgumentCaptor I discover it does not work as expected with child classes. This article describe a workaround to keep using it.

item.title: Network anomaly detection
item.description: Discover how Random Forest classification can be used to spot anomalies in network traffic. This blog post dives into applying machine learning in InfoSec to boost threat detection accuracy and stay ahead of intruders in real time.

item.title: Parse huge local json file
item.description: How to parse a huge JSON file only in the browser. This implementation uses an undocumented Oboejs technique to process the file in batches

item.title: Keep the UI responsive by using web worker
item.description: Prevent UI freezes in your Leaflet GPX app by offloading large file parsing to Web Workers, ensuring smooth user experience.

item.title: Python app structure
item.description: Description of how you should organise a Python executable application to publish and generate an executable

item.title: Python cli application
item.description: In this article I describe how to create a python cli application using the click library and install it using pipx

item.title: Raspberry Pi for QA
item.description: The design and implementation of multiple QA services (Network tweaking, VPN, Packet analysis,..) on a NodeJS server on a Raspberry Pi

item.title: Relational model in DynamoDB
item.description: In this post I implement the persistence of a relational model in DynamoDB. Fix some challenges using ECS to perform long running DynamoDB operations

item.title: Push notifications SNS and Firebase
item.description: This post describe how I setup SNS to communicate with Firebase to send push notifications to Android and iOS devices

item.title: Standalone application for Raspberry Pi
item.description: The design, implementation and continuous integration of a standalone application to be run on a Raspberry Pi.

item.title: Terraform State Surgery: migrating the infrastructure
item.description: When your Terraform configuration grows to manage dozens of environments across multiple applications, eventually you need to split things up. You can't just delete code and walk away. Do that, and Terraform will destroy your production infrastructure.

item.title: Testing python BaseHttpServer
item.description: While BaseHttpServer is very fancy for quick and dirty tests, it's not easy to do testing on it. Discover how do I manage to test BaseHttpServer and mock dependencies

item.title: Tips for developers facing unfamiliar codebases
item.description: Tips and mindset shifts for developers facing messy, unfamiliar code and not knowing where to start in real-world projects.

item.title: Timeseries database with DynamoDB
item.description: Design, challenges and implementation of a DynamoDB timeseries database using AWS Lambda, Kinesis and DynamoDB Streams
